Description

30A ESCAPES presents…“HP 315 Condo” at High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach! Wake up to breathtaking ocean views, soak up the sun by the lagoon-style pool, and embrace laid-back luxury in a newly renovated space designed for unforgettable getaways. Steps from Rosemary Beach and vibrant local spots, this is where relaxation meets adventure. Perfect for families or friends looking to escape the ordinary. Seasonal beach chair service included—paradise is calling! Learn more below...

*** HIGHLIGHTS ***
  • Stunning Pool Views from the Main Balcony – Wake up to breathtaking views of a serene resort pool, setting the perfect tone for a relaxing getaway.
  • Just Steps to Dining, Shopping, and Iconic Rosemary Beach – Enjoy the ultimate convenience of having charming boutiques, delicious eateries, and the beauty of Rosemary Beach right at your doorstep.
  • Newly Renovated, Bright, and Open Living Spaces – Experience modern coastal elegance with spacious, stylish interiors designed for comfort and connection.
  • Seasonal Beach Chair Service Included – Relax effortlessly with complimentary beach chair service, making your sun-soaked days even more enjoyable.
  • Onsite Beachfront Bar and Grill - Crabby Steve’s – Savor laid-back vibes and oceanfront dining at this hidden gem, just steps from the sand.

Eager to Read More?

Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:

⭐"The condo was absolutely stunning, with breathtaking views of the pool and beach. We can't wait to return!" – Sandra
⭐"We absolutely loved the location! Everything was within walking distance, and the lagoon pool was simply gorgeous." – Rebecca
⭐"Our family had an unforgettable trip. The condo was spotless, beautifully updated, and perfectly located near shops and restaurants." – Jack

*** LIVING AREA ***

Indulge in modern coastal elegance with open, light-filled living spaces crafted for ultimate relaxation. The living room invites you to sink into luxurious plush seating, enjoy entertainment on the flat-screen TV, or step through the sliding doors onto a private balcony. From there, take in breathtaking views of the sparkling lagoon-like pool—your perfect retreat after a sun-soaked day at the beach!

  • Spacious Open Concept Design with Plenty of Comfortable Seating
  • Sleek Flat-Screen TV Paired with Elegant Coastal-Inspired Decor
  • Stunning Pool and Gulf Views from the Main Balcony, Featuring a Dining Table for 4 and Generous Seating Options
*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***

Cook up a feast or prepare light snacks in the freshly remodeled kitchen. With stainless steel appliances and plenty of counter space, this kitchen is both functional and beautiful. Gather around the large dining table to share meals or your latest beach adventures!

  • Stunningly Renovated Kitchen Featuring Modern Stainless Steel Appliances
  • Elegant Dining Table Perfectly Designed to Seat 6 Guests in Comfort
  • Inviting Breakfast Bar with Stylish Seating for 3, Ideal for Casual Mornings
*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***

Sleep in style and comfort! Each bedroom is designed with serene, modern decor, equipped with flat-screen TVs, and plenty of storage to keep your space clutter-free.

  • Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.
  • King Guest Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo.
  • Queen Guest Suite: 2 Queen Beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, shower/tub combo and secondary hall access.
*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***

Guests will be treated to an unparalleled experience at High Pointe Resort, where every detail is designed for ultimate enjoyment. Dive into the stunning lagoon-style pool, unwind at Crabby Steve’s Beachfront Bar with breathtaking ocean views, and indulge in world-class amenities that promise to make every moment truly unforgettable.

  • Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.
  • Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a Large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot Tub
  • Beach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean Views
  • Exclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and Privacy
  • Amenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach Enthusiasts
  • Well-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports Lovers
  • Children's Playground for the Little Ones
  • Shuffleboard Court for Family Fun
  • BBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining
*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***

Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, this stunning condo blends comfort with unbeatable convenience. Stroll over to the charming streets of Rosemary Beach or Alys Beach to enjoy boutique shopping, fine dining, and breathtaking coastal views. Just steps away, Peddlers Pavilion awaits with live music, delicious ice cream, and a lively atmosphere perfect for making memories.

  • Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.
  • Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.
  • Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.
  • Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.
*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***
  • Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently
  • We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.
  • Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.
  • LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.
  • High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.
  • This property has 1 included beach set-up available 3/6 to 10/31, featuring 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.
*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***

At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***

Property trimmed the palm tree while we were there so the view of the ocean was great! Would rent again. Good for our family of 5 (3 kids under 4)

HP Unit 315 - CUTE AND CLEAN!
This was my first stay at High Pointe and we loved it. Unit 315 has is beautifully renovated. The kitchen has so much charm and is well stocked. The unit seemed very clean and fresh. The towels and sheets even seemed fresh, which was a very nice surprise. I would come back to High Point and stay in unit 315 again! 30A escapes was very easy to work with. My favorite part was getting a text message the morning of our arrival with a personal contact and summary information about check in. I was able to text this person directly a few questions in real time right when we were arriving. It was SO helpful and easy. They communication from 30A escapes via email and text was GREAT.

Our family had a great time staying in unit 315. There was plenty of space, the unit was beautiful and clean, and we liked our location on the property. Couldn't Have been Happier!

Great property and great location! The kitchen was filled with more pots, pans and dishes than the 6 of us could ever use, and the layout of the kitchen made it easy for several of us to be in there at once. Comfortable beds and blackout curtains ensured a great night’s sleep! Plenty of space for the 6 of us to sit in the living room AND on the balcony. The location was just steps from the swimming pool and it was less than a 5 minute walk from the condo’s front door to the chairs that were set up for us in the beach. The bikes were a nice added value that the kids enjoyed! I had a question about them and was able to get in touch with Saxon who had an immediate and helpful answer for me. We loved this condo and will definitely check to see if it’s available the next time we come to Rosemary Beach!
